basic_info.description: Hi 👋 I'm Dhanvi Kashyap. I am a Computer Science Student at the University of Pittsburgh, deeply interested in the power of data and its potential to drive intelligent, meaningful solutions. Whether through academic research or industry experience, I’m eager to collaborate on projects that apply advanced data techniques to create meaningful, user-centered solutions and contribute to the future of technology.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science- B.S., Computer Science
Research Assistant: Worked as a research assistant under Dr. Erin Walker as part of the FACET Lab to build a voice assistant to assist older adults to build their information literacy skills.
Leadership: Worked as the Business Manager for Mastana Fusion Dance Club, in charge of managing a $5,000+ annual budget, allocating funds for performances, competitions, and travel.
coursework: CS441 Discrete Structures for Computer Science, CS445 Data Structures and Algorithms 1, CS447 Computer Organization & Assembly, CS 449 Introduction to Systems Software, CS 1501 Data Structures & Algorithms 2, CS 1502 Formal Methods in Computer Science

projects.title: Campus Guide Chatbot
projects.description: Developed a proof of concept chatbot using large language models (LLMs) and Python to web scrape 200+ pages of school data and automate FAQ responses.

experience.title: Undergraduate Researcher
content: Investigate how adults (65+) build information literacy skills to reduce the spread of misinformation online, focusing on usability barriers and information verification behaviors.

Collaborate on developing a voice-based interaction system using the Amazon Alexa Skills Kit (ASK) and OpenAI’s GPT model, enabling Alexa to recognize user intent and provide either native functionality or GPT-powered conversational responses for senior adults.

experience.title: Data Engineering & AI Intern
content: Leveraged enterprise analytics platforms (Business 360, Agency 360, Competitor 360) to identify competitor and agency performance trends, producing insights that informed pricing and underwriting strategies.
Designed and developed a traffic congestion risk metric, enabling underwriters to evaluate how location-based congestion affects premiums and reducing assessment time by 30%.
Built a metric to quantify homeless encampment exposure risk, collaborating with the Commercial Insurance (CI) team to extend framework applicability across 3+ additional risk factors.

experience.title: Software Engineering Consultant
content: Designed and maintained scalable backend systems for an educational platform, optimizing APIs and database performance by 40% to support medical terminology learning.
Developed a web application using React and Supabase for database management and authentication, utilizing JSON-based data handling for seamless client-server communication.
Collaborated in an agile environment with the frontend UX/UI team to ensure seamless integration and optimize performance, improving user experience.

experience.title: Data Tester
content: Conducted weekly data testing to identify and resolve technical issues, ensuring the website’s functionality and readiness before public launch.
Collaborated with data developers to implement new designs, enhancing website user-friendliness and reducing software processing time.
